phase_prompt.label: Phase 3
phase_prompt.summary: Twilight/Transitional Day – crystalline sun dissolves into a fiber‑optic cable mountain, dusky indigo sky.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic 9:16 vertical shot of a twilight scene in an ancient‑tech Ethiopian setting, where the crystalline sun has transformed into a towering white cable mountain composed of fiber‑optic wool. The sky turns dusky indigo, and bioluminescent glyphs pulse with a soft glow. The reflective obsidian ground mirrors the network of data light, creating a surreal, grounded yet mystical atmosphere.
